description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for HTTP Bmo Response object, including function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the object.

methods.name: HttpCreateBmoRep
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Http Bmo Response object, taking container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: HttpBmoRepCreate
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP Bmo Response object with specified context and reserved handles.

methods.name: HttpBmoRepRemove
methods.description: Removes or deletes an existing HTTP Bmo Response object.

methods.name: HttpBmoRepEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects within the HTTP Bmo Response object.

methods.name: HttpBmoRepInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP Bmo Response object.
